output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Everyone who can get the flag is on build 7.4.0, because the capability needed to be eligible first shipped in that build. Build 7.4.0 crashed at about 2% from 2 September, before the flag ramp began, while 7.3.2 stayed near 0.7%. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash at 2.10% and a random flag-off holdout at 1.98%. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. Device mix and usage are the same across groups. The largest crash cluster in 7.4.0 is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library, which has no canvas frames and is absent from 7.3.2. The crash-reporting SDK change is not the cause: the app store's own console shows the same gap. The 9 September backend deployment shows no effect on 7.3.2. Next steps: do not ship 7.4.0 to 100%. Hold it at 25% and fix the Pixelda decode crash. Do not mark the incident resolved. Keep the flag's holdout measuring, and widening it would speed that up. A small flag effect of a few tenths of a point has not been ruled out, so rework of the canvas memory handling would be premature for now.
